notes: Mid-market collaboration SaaS (team docs + threaded chat). Interested in adding LLM-based summarization + 'smart replies' and code-assist snippets for power users.

Token mix observed: 65% short responses (<150 tokens) for smart replies, 25% mid (150-800) for summarization, 10% long (>800) for code-assist snippets. Avg tokens per request ~220.
Monthly extrapolation from trial (expected product launch in 2 months): baseline 18M tokens/mo, peak 1.2k QPS (30-min burst windows), concurrency target 80-120 during spikes.

Security: require SSO (SAML), KMS integration for customer keys, audit logs retention 1 year, and data residency US only. VPC peering mandatory for Dedicated.

use_case_summary: Primary: real-time 'smart replies' in chat (low latency, short tokens) + document summarization (mid tokens) + occasional code-assist (long tokens). Needs consistent p95 latency <500ms for short replies, acceptable p95 <800ms for mids, and batch-friendly handling of long responses. Must support SSO and VPC peering. Wants Dedicated reserved capacity with autoscale burst for product launch.
